description: This Java class represents a Submission entity in a Learning Management System (LMS). It is a JPA entity mapped to the 'submissions' database table, containing fields such as id, assignmentId, studentId, content, and submittedAt, along with constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Submission
classes.description: JPA entity class for storing assignment submission details including id, assignmentId, studentId, content, and submission timestamp.

methods.name: Submission(Long assignmentId, Long studentId, String content)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Submission with assignment ID, student ID, and content.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the submission.

methods.name: getAssignmentId()
methods.description: Returns the assignment ID associated with the submission.

methods.name: getStudentId()
methods.description: Returns the student ID who submitted.

methods.name: getSubmittedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the submission was made.

methods.name: setContent(String content)
methods.description: Updates the content and refreshes the submission timestamp.
